            #!/bin/bash
            # Boot script for one Mvelaphanda app instance (rendered by Terraform): the traffic tool, its name,
            # and a systemd service (TCP sink on 9000, HTTP service on 8080). Python 3 stdlib only.
            set -euxo pipefail
            mkdir -p /opt/mvela /var/tmp/mvela
            echo '' | base64 -d | gunzip > /opt/mvela/mvela_traffic.py
            echo 'NAME=app-a' > /etc/mvela.conf
            cat > /etc/systemd/system/mvela-svc.service <<'UNIT'
            [Unit]
            Description=Mvelaphanda app service (bulk TCP sink 9000, HTTP 8080)
            After=network-online.target
            
            [Service]
            ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u /opt/mvela/mvela_traffic.py serve
            Restart=always
            RestartSec=2
            
            [Install]
            WantedBy=multi-user.target
            UNIT
            systemctl daemon-reload
            systemctl enable --now mvela-svc
            sleep 2
            systemctl is-active mvela-svc
            sha256sum /opt/mvela/mvela_traffic.py
            echo "mvela app ready: app-a"
        EOT

            #!/bin/bash
            # Boot script for one Mvelaphanda app instance (rendered by Terraform): the traffic tool, its name,
            # and a systemd service (TCP sink on 9000, HTTP service on 8080). Python 3 stdlib only.
            set -euxo pipefail
            mkdir -p /opt/mvela /var/tmp/mvela
            echo '' | base64 -d | gunzip > /opt/mvela/mvela_traffic.py
            echo 'NAME=app-b' > /etc/mvela.conf
            cat > /etc/systemd/system/mvela-svc.service <<'UNIT'
            [Unit]
            Description=Mvelaphanda app service (bulk TCP sink 9000, HTTP 8080)
            After=network-online.target
            
            [Service]
            ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -u /opt/mvela/mvela_traffic.py serve
            Restart=always
            RestartSec=2
            
            [Install]
            WantedBy=multi-user.target
            UNIT
            systemctl daemon-reload
            systemctl enable --now mvela-svc
            sleep 2
            systemctl is-active mvela-svc
            sha256sum /opt/mvela/mvela_traffic.py
            echo "mvela app ready: app-b"
